title: correlation-envelope
description: Versioned cross-plane correlation/event envelope (issue #272, ADR-0032 rule 5). EVIDENCE, NOT AUTHORITY: it carries identifiers, a closed status, freshness, classification and redaction state so that OMES, Hermes, AWCMS and providers can be correlated and converged. It never carries prompts, transcripts, commands, tool arguments/results, headers, credentials or reasoning, and it never grants permission or approves anything. Timestamps are UTC (`Z`) RFC 3339 strings because `format` is not in the supported validator subset; calendar validity is checked by lib/omes/py/observability/envelope.py.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Only major version 1 exists; a consumer MUST fail closed on any other major version.

event_id.description: Producer-unique event identifier; the deduplication key. Reusing an event_id with different content is rejected by the convergence reducer.

source_authority.description: Which authority produced the observation (mirrors the authority enum of contracts/architecture/v1/capabilities.schema.json). The producer is a witness, not the owner of the other planes' state.

causation_id.description: event_id of the event that directly caused this one; null or absent for a root event.

trace_id.description: W3C Trace Context trace-id: 32 lowercase hex characters, not all zeros.

span_id.description: W3C Trace Context parent-id/span-id: 16 lowercase hex characters, not all zeros.

operation.description: Allowlisted operation NAME only (never a command line).

observed_at.description: When the producer recorded this envelope (UTC, RFC 3339, `Z` suffix).

source_timestamp.description: When the underlying event happened at its source (UTC, RFC 3339, `Z` suffix). The convergence ordering key.

freshness.description: Producer's statement about the evidence. Missing or unverifiable evidence is `unknown`, never `live`.

status.description: Closed, normalized lifecycle vocabulary. Terminal: succeeded, failed, cancelled, interrupted, expired, rolled_back. Non-terminal: pending, running, unknown. `unknown` means the source cannot prove the outcome; it is never converted to success. A closed enum (not free text) is used so convergence rules are well defined and no free-text channel exists.

evidence_ref.description: Opaque reference to evidence held elsewhere (for example an audit record locator). Never the evidence itself.

classification.description: Data classification of the envelope per ADR-0029 / docs/ai-data-privacy-and-model-security.md section 4. Required; there is no default.

redaction_state.description: none_required: carries only identifiers and enums; redacted: a sensitive value was removed before emission; withheld: the producer deliberately omitted detail.
